Define a Strictly Typed Field in an Extraction Schema

Source: R/schema.R
schema_field.Rd

Creates a field specification for use inside extraction_schema(). Enforces strict scalar typing (character, integer, numeric, logical, enum), explicit nullability, numeric bounds, string length bounds, and PCRE regex patterns.

Usage

schema_field(
  type = c("character", "integer", "numeric", "logical", "enum"),
  description = "",
  nullable = FALSE,
  values = NULL,
  min = NULL,
  max = NULL,
  pattern = NULL,
  min_length = NULL,
  max_length = NULL
)

Arguments

type

Character scalar field type: "character", "integer", "numeric", "logical", or "enum".

description

Character scalar human-readable instructions for the LLM.

nullable

Logical scalar; whether JSON null (NA in R) is permitted. Defaults to FALSE.

values

Character vector of allowed levels (required when type = "enum").

min

Optional numeric minimum bound (valid for "integer" and "numeric").

max

Optional numeric maximum bound (valid for "integer" and "numeric").

pattern

Optional PCRE regular expression constraint (valid for "character").

min_length

Optional non-negative integer minimum string length (valid for "character").

max_length

Optional positive integer maximum string length (valid for "character").

Value

An S3 object of class "airgap_schema_field".

Examples

schema_field("enum", values = c("low", "moderate", "high"), description = "Risk tier")
#> $type
#> [1] "enum"
#> 
#> $description
#> [1] "Risk tier"
#> 
#> $nullable
#> [1] FALSE
#> 
#> $values
#> [1] "low"      "moderate" "high"    
#> 
#> $min
#> NULL
#> 
#> $max
#> NULL
#> 
#> $pattern
#> NULL
#> 
#> $min_length
#> NULL
#> 
#> $max_length
#> NULL
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "airgap_schema_field"
schema_field("integer", min = 0L, max = 10L, description = "Severity rating")
#> $type
#> [1] "integer"
#> 
#> $description
#> [1] "Severity rating"
#> 
#> $nullable
#> [1] FALSE
#> 
#> $values
#> NULL
#> 
#> $min
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> $max
#> [1] 10
#> 
#> $pattern
#> NULL
#> 
#> $min_length
#> NULL
#> 
#> $max_length
#> NULL
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "airgap_schema_field"
